# rbxcdn.com
> Roblox's content delivery domain serving static assets, game resources, client files, and platform media.

rbxcdn.com is used across the Roblox ecosystem to host versioned client downloads, images, thumbnails, avatar assets, and other static content consumed by Roblox apps, web properties, and developer tooling. It is primarily an asset and distribution domain rather than a standalone documentation site.

## Platform and Developer Documentation
- [Roblox Creator Hub](https://create.roblox.com/): Central documentation hub for Roblox development, publishing, and platform features.
- [Roblox Documentation](https://create.roblox.com/docs): Official docs for engine APIs, Studio workflows, and platform systems.
- [Roblox API Reference](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine): Reference documentation for Roblox engine classes, members, and types.
- [Open Cloud Documentation](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud): Docs for Roblox Open Cloud APIs, authentication, and service usage.
- [Roblox DevForum](https://devforum.roblox.com/): Community forum for platform announcements, technical discussion, and developer support.

## Open Cloud and Web APIs
- [Open Cloud Overview](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud): Introduction to Roblox Open Cloud services and authentication patterns.
- [Assets API](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/assets): Manage asset upload and related asset workflows through Open Cloud.
- [Data Stores API](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores): Access and manage persistent experience data with cloud endpoints.
- [Messaging API](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/messaging): Publish messages across servers using Roblox cloud messaging services.
- [Place Publishing API](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/usage-place-publishing): Publish place files programmatically using Open Cloud workflows.
- [Web APIs Overview](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/legacy): Legacy and web-facing API guidance for Roblox integrations.

- [Data Types](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes): Reference for built-in Roblox data types and structures.
- [Enums](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/enums): Enumeration reference for engine constants and option sets.
- [Globals](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/globals): Global functions, libraries, and runtime-provided APIs.
